# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Prettier formatting

- printWidth 100, semicolons, double quotes, trailing commas everywhere. Formatting stays uniform across the codebase, except `public/blackfriday/` (the static Black Friday LP), which is excluded from ESLint (`eslint.config.js` `ignores`) and Prettier (`.prettierignore`).
- Enforced by `eslint-plugin-prettier/recommended` in `eslint.config.js` and by `.prettierrc`. Run `npm run format`.

### 2. TypeScript strict + typescript-eslint recommended

- Files are typed strictly. `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` is `off`.
- Enforced by `tsconfig.json` `strict` and by `tseslint.configs.recommended` in `eslint.config.js`.

### 3. No `server-only` package

- TanStack Start does not use the Next.js `server-only` package. Mark server-only code with a `*.server.ts` filename (`src/lib/lead.server.ts`, `src/lib/bf-lead.server.ts`, `src/lib/meta-capi.server.ts`) or with `@tanstack/react-start/server-only`.
- Enforced by ESLint `no-restricted-imports` (`error`) in `eslint.config.js`.

### 4. React hooks rules + refresh-safe exports

- Hooks follow the rules of hooks. Component modules export components, plus constants where needed.
- Enforced by `reactHooks.configs.recommended.rules` and by `react-refresh/only-export-components` (`warn`, `allowConstantExport: true`) in `eslint.config.js`.

### 5. Content as module-level UPPER_CASE arrays mapped to JSX

- Copy lives in `const` arrays and the JSX maps over them, so text edits don't touch markup. Examples: `FAQS` (`interactive.tsx`), `SERVICE_OPTIONS` (`src/lib/lead-schema.ts`), `STEPS`, `COMPARISON`, `RISKS`, `PRECISION`, `IDEAL_YES`, `IDEAL_NO` (`sections.tsx`), `PROJECTS`, `TESTIMONIALS` (`portfolio.tsx`), `NAV` (`chrome.tsx`).

### 6. Compose sections from landing primitives

- Every section wraps its content in `Section` (`relative py-24 md:py-32`, `max-w-7xl` container) and uses `Eyebrow`, `Heading`, `GoldRule`, and `GoldCTA` from `src/components/landing/primitives.tsx`, which keeps rhythm and branding consistent.

### 7. `@/` path alias + `cn()` for class merging

- Imports use `@/components/...`, `@/lib/...`, `@/assets/...`. The alias is `"@/*": ["./src/*"]` in `tsconfig.json`, and `components.json` maps the shadcn aliases to it.
- Conditional classes go through `cn()` = `twMerge(clsx(...))` from `src/lib/utils.ts`.

### 8. Import binary assets directly, never `.asset.json`

- Components import real files: `import ogImage from "@/assets/lp/og-image.jpg"` (`src/routes/__root.tsx`), `import logoWebp from "@/assets/lp/logo.webp"` (`chrome.tsx`), and `import heroDesktopWebp from "@/assets/lp/hero-desktop.webp"` (`hero.tsx`).
- `*.asset.json` stubs (11 in `src/assets/`) are read by `scripts/download-assets.mjs` to fetch their binaries.

### 9. Don't touch generated or bundled pieces

- `src/routeTree.gen.ts` is generated by the router plugin. Keep `<Outlet />` in `RootComponent` (`src/routes/__root.tsx`, inline comment).
- Don't re-add plugins that `@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config` already bundles (tanstackStart, viteReact, tailwindcss, tsConfigPaths, nitro, devtools). The header comment in `vite.config.ts` says so.

### 10. Server lead code never throws and never logs PII

- A throw in a lead handler becomes the HTML 500 from `errorMiddleware`, so handlers return `Response` objects. Logs carry event names and `event_id`, never URLs, emails, or phones.
- Stated in the header comments of `src/lib/lead.server.ts`, `src/lib/bf-lead.server.ts`, and `src/lib/meta-capi.server.ts`. No lint rule enforces it.

### 11. One zod schema for browser and server

- `src/lib/lead-schema.ts` holds `leadSchema` and imports only `zod` (no `@/` imports), so the browser form and `handleLead` run the same rules.
- Imported by `src/components/landing/interactive.tsx` and `src/lib/lead.server.ts`. No lint rule enforces it.
